response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rate_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.avg_rate_per_day - o.mean_rate_per_day AS difference_from_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.mean_rate_per_day;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff selects films with replacement_cost at least 20.99; the request does not specify the direction or whether the boundary is included.
